title: A standard-simplex copower does not change a simplicial abelian group in the derived category
statement:
Let $A_\bullet:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Ab}$ be a simplicial abelian group and let $m\geq0$ [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object]. Define the simplicial abelian group $P_m(A)$ by
$$P_m(A)_n=\bigoplus_{\alpha:[n]\to[m]\text{ in }\Delta}A_n.$$
Write $e_\alpha(a)$ for $a$ in the indicated summand. For $\varphi:[k]\to[n]$ its operator sends $e_\alpha(a)$ to $e_{\alpha\varphi}(A(\varphi)(a))$. Let $\varepsilon:P_m(A)\to A$ send every $e_\alpha(a)$ to $a$. For any simplicial abelian group $B$, let $s(B)$ be the cochain complex with $s(B)^{-n}=B_n$ for $n\geq0$, zero in positive degrees, and differential $\sum_{i=0}^n(-1)^id_i$ in degree $-n$ for $n\geq1$. The morphism
$$s(\varepsilon):s(P_m(A))\longrightarrow s(A)$$
is an isomorphism in $D(\mathrm{Ab})$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], natural in morphisms of simplicial abelian groups $A\to A'$.

source.place: Tag 08RX (lemma-O-homology-qis), proof, the augmentations X_bullet to P_bullet and X_prime_bullet to P_prime_bullet, for S_bullet=Delta[m]; its contraction is simplicial.tex Tag 08Q3 (example-simplex-contractible), followed by Tag 019S (lemma-homotopy-s-N). The assertion is formulated for an arbitrary simplicial abelian coefficient group.

proof.text: Let $c_{m,n}:[n]\to[m]$ be constant with value $m$, and define $i_n:A_n\to P_m(A)_n$ by $i_n(a)=e_{c_{m,n}}(a)$. Since $c_{m,n}\varphi=c_{m,k}$ for every $\varphi:[k]\to[n]$, these maps commute with every simplicial operator. The summation maps $\varepsilon_n$ also commute with the operators, as both composites send $e_\alpha(a)$ to $A(\varphi)(a)$. Thus $i$ and $\varepsilon$ are simplicial morphisms and $\varepsilon i=\mathrm{id}_A$.

source.place: Tag 08Q3 (example-simplex-contractible); the coefficient-copower argument of sites-cohomology.tex Tag 08RX (lemma-O-homology-qis), proof

proof.text: Construct a homotopy on underlying simplicial sets explicitly. For $\beta:[n]\to[1]$ and $x=\sum_\alpha e_\alpha(a_\alpha)$, put $H_n(x,\beta)=\sum_\alpha e_{\gamma_{\alpha,\beta}}(a_\alpha)$, where $\gamma_{\alpha,\beta}(j)=\alpha(j)$ if $\beta(j)=0$, and $m$ otherwise. This is order-preserving: on the zero part use monotonicity of $\alpha$, on the one part it is constant, and across the cut use $\alpha(j)\le m$. All sums are finite. For $\varphi:[k]\to[n]$, the equality $\gamma_{\alpha,\beta}\varphi=\gamma_{\alpha\varphi,\beta\varphi}$ and additivity of $A(\varphi)$ show, term by term, that applying the simplicial operator to $H_n(x,\beta)$ gives $H_k(P_m(A)(\varphi)x,\beta\varphi)$; coinciding summands simply add. Hence $H:UP_m(A)\times\Delta[1]\to UP_m(A)$ is a simplicial map. At the constant parameter $0$ it is $x$, and at the constant parameter $1$ it is $e_{c_{m,n}}(\sum_\alpha a_\alpha)=i_n\varepsilon_n(x)$. Together with $\varepsilon i=\mathrm{id}$ this is an underlying simplicial-set homotopy inverse for $\varepsilon$, with inverse $Ui$.

source.place: Tag 08Q3 (example-simplex-contractible); the coefficient-copower argument of sites-cohomology.tex Tag 08RX (lemma-O-homology-qis), proof

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-simplicial-abelian-set-homotopy-quasi-iso] with $X=P_m(A)$, $Y=A$, $f=\varepsilon$ and $g=Ui$. Its hypotheses hold by the explicit homotopy and the identity in the preceding steps (the identity supplies the other constant homotopy). Its alternating nonpositive cochain complexes are exactly the complexes $s(P_m(A))$ and $s(A)$ in the statement, so $s(\varepsilon)$ is a quasi-isomorphism. By the localization defining $D(\mathrm{Ab})$ in [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], its image is invertible.

For a simplicial morphism $u:A\to A^{\prime}$ define $P_m(u)_n(e_\alpha(a))=e_\alpha(u_n(a))$. It commutes with every operator because $u_kA(\varphi)=A^{\prime}(\varphi)u_n$. On each summand, $\varepsilon_{A^{\prime}}P_m(u)=u\varepsilon_A$ sends $e_\alpha(a)$ to $u_n(a)$; likewise $P_m(u)i_A=i_{A^{\prime}}u$. Thus the augmentation square commutes degreewise, then as cochain maps and after localization. The already invertible augmentations therefore constitute the asserted natural isomorphism (their inverses are natural by multiplying this square by the inverses).

Step 1: the last-vertex map i and the summation map ε are simplicial and εi=id. Step 2: γ_{α,β} is exactly the 08Q3 formula. It is monotone across the cut because α≤m, natural because γ_{α,β}φ=γ_{αφ,βφ} (colliding summands add, since A(φ) is additive), and its endpoints are c_0→id and c_1→iε. The elementary flag is acceptable. Step 3: every hypothesis of lem-trf-simplicial-abelian-set-homotopy-quasi-iso holds: f=ε additive, g=Ui, a one-step homotopy id→gf, and fg=id. Its s(·) convention matches the item's, and the localization in def-weil-abstract-derived-category makes Q(s(ε)) invertible. Step 4: the naturality square for P_m(u) commutes on each summand e_α(a). Edge cases m=0, A=0, degree 0 and non-injective φ are all fine. The citer lem-sfb-simplicial-flat-base-change-quasi-iso uses the statement as written.
